why: Current baseline practice for Thanjavur (Cauvery Delta), Tamil Nadu: Puddled Rice → Puddled Rice → Blackgram.
Conventional puddled transplanted rice (PTR) creates continuous water table depletion and narrow turnaround windows.
Post-harvest residue burning depletes topsoil organic matter, microbial biomass, and volatile nitrogen. Narrow 11-day harvest-to-sowing turnaround increases stubble burning pressure.
Baseline water demand averages 1930 mm/yr, with a 10-year SOC balance of -0.03 t C/ha and soil health index of 50/100 [FAO-56, RothC-26.3].
Baseline median net return is ₹294,463/ha, dropping to ₹207,168/ha in severe drought years (CVaR-10).

narrative_summary: Strategy 'Puddled Rice → Puddled Rice → Blackgram': Requires 1930 mm/yr net seasonal irrigation [FAO-56]. Helps sustain positive regional groundwater storage (NASA GRACE-FO trend: +0.6 cm/yr). RothC forecasts a 10-year soil organic carbon change of -0.0 t C/ha, elevating soil health to 50/100. Under CACP MSP (2024-25) policies, median expected return is ₹294,463/ha with a worst-10% drought buffer (CVaR-10) of ₹207,168/ha.

why: Saves 56% irrigation water (1085 mm/yr — ~14 flood irrigations and 597 hrs/ha of borewell pumping) vs. baseline [FAO-56]. Helps sustain positive regional groundwater storage (NASA GRACE-FO trend: +0.6 cm/yr).

Elevates Soil Health Score to 83/100 (+33 pts vs. baseline) and changes 10-year topsoil organic carbon by +2.3 t C/ha, saving 5.1 bags/ha of 45-kg Urea via biological N fixation [RothC-lite · SoilGrids].
Provides a 34-day inter-season turnaround window for direct/zero-till seeding with in-situ residue mulching — avoiding seasonal stubble burning monitored by NASA FIRMS.
Timely sowing schedule buffers crops against 138 annual extreme heat days (>35°C) and 44.1 grain-filling terminal heat days (>32°C) recorded by NASA POWER.

Delivers median net operating return of ₹292,517/ha (₹118,378/acre) with a worst-10% drought downside buffer (CVaR-10) of ₹266,191/ha (₹107,724/acre) [CACP MSP 2024-25]. Eligible schemes: Tamil Nadu Kalaignarin Rice Fallow Pulses Mission (100% certified seed subsidy); Tamil Nadu Sustainable Dryland & Water Conservation Mission.
